faq.title: We’re here to help.
faq.copy: Here are a few things to know before taking your store online.

one.question: What is Menuku?
one.answer: Menuku helps food businesses create a digital catalog with menus, photos, prices, location, and contact details in one link.

two.question: Do customers need an account?
two.answer: No. Customers can open your store link and browse the menu right away.

three.question: Can I update my menu after sharing it?
three.answer: Anytime from your dashboard. Your store link stays the same.

four.question: How do I pay for a plan?
four.answer: Pay by QRIS through Pakasir or choose manual transfer and ask our admin for the details.

five.question: Can customers order directly through Menuku?
five.answer: Menuku shows your catalog and contact buttons so customers can ask questions or order directly from your store.
